title: NRP1 promotes hepatic fibrosis by regulating Src/Rab7-mediated lysosomal degradation of TβRI
task: Elucidate NRP1-mediated control of TGF-β receptor stability in hepatic fibrosis
key_results: NRP1/Src/Rab7 axis regulates TβRI lysosomal degradation during hepatic stellate cell activation
comments: The abstract lacks quantitative results; full paper analysis would be needed to assess effect magnitudes and mechanistic sufficiency of this pathway in HSC-driven fibrosis progression.

hypotheses.hypothesis: NRP1 promotes hepatic fibrosis by stabilizing TGF-β signaling through inhibition of TβRI degradation
hypotheses.result: NRP1/Src/Rab7 axis suppresses TβRI lysosomal degradation (result pending full paper review)

title: Differentiation-coupled formation of core clock protein interactions in mouse embryonic stem cells
task: Map core clock protein complex assembly during ES cell differentiation
key_results: BMAL1-CLOCK-PER1-CRY1/2 interactions form from day 14 onward coinciding with circadian rhythm emergence; PER1-CRY1/2-CKIδ complexes exist even in undifferentiated ES cells
comments: The study elegantly uses endogenous tagging to preserve native protein levels and reveals temporal uncoupling of clock component expression from functional complex assembly, suggesting post-translational control gates circadian competence.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Clock protein complexes form progressively during differentiation to establish circadian competence
hypotheses.result: BMAL1-CLOCK-PER1-CRY1/2 assembly initiates at day 14, coinciding with circadian rhythm emergence

hypotheses.hypothesis: PER1-CRY1/2 interactions are independent of differentiation state
hypotheses.result: PER1-CRY1/2-CKIδ complexes detected throughout differentiation including undifferentiated ES cells

title: Searching for BBB permeable phytochemical inhibitors for targeting brain cancer associated HER2 protein through free energy calculations and pharmacokinetic analysis
task: BBB-permeable HER2 inhibitors for brain cancer via virtual screening
key_results: Veratramine and Hydroxysanguinarine show comparable/better binding affinity than Tucatinib; identified novel scaffolds via Tanimoto similarity
comments: In silico study lacks experimental validation; BBB permeability predictions based on computational models which may not fully translate to in vivo efficacy.

model_io.model: Molecular docking + MD simulations + MMPBSA free energy

hypotheses.hypothesis: Natural phytochemicals can achieve BBB permeability and HER2 inhibition comparable to FDA drugs
hypotheses.result: Two candidates identified with favorable properties; validation pending

title: Explainable and clinically audited hybrid self-supervised framework for multi-class DFU classification and mobile deployment
task: Multi-class DFU classification with explainability and mobile deployment
key_results: 99.98% accuracy; 99.93% F1-score; 0.9993 macro F1 (clinician-audited); 87.5% clinical interpretability (Grad-CAM); 180 ms inference on mobile
comments: Impressive performance but test set only 3,600 images; external validation on independent clinical cohorts and comparison with dermatologist performance would strengthen claims.

inputs: DFU images (24,000 total; 19.2k train, 1.2k val, 3.6k test)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid self-supervised pretraining + spatial refinement achieves high accuracy and clinical interpretability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 99.98% accuracy with 87.5% expert-confirmed Grad-CAM interpretability

title: Genomic analysis identifies candidate SOS-associated and EPS/envelope-remodeling islands in a drinking-water Stenotrophomonas maltophilia complex isolate
task: Genomic features supporting persistence of drinking-water Stenotrophomonas maltophilia
key_results: Identified GI_4 (SOS/stress-response genes) and GI_6 (EPS/envelope-remodeling) candidate islands; predicted 1,920 transporters (23% metal-related); moderate biofilm formation and plateau H₂O₂ survival
comments: Single-isolate study with correlation not causation; Switch–Shield hypothesis is hypothesis-generating and requires targeted mutant assays and DWDS-mimetic flow-reactor validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: SOS-response and EPS/envelope-remodeling genomic islands support stress tolerance in DWDS
hypotheses.result: Supported by genomic architecture and phenotypic trends, but direct causality undemonstrated

title: Integrative exosomal RNA analysis reveals the hsa-miR-186-5p–CADM1 axis in plasma cell-mediated inflammation of allergic rhinitis
task: Identify exosomal miRNA-target axis in allergic rhinitis plasma cell inflammation
key_results: hsa-miR-186-5p significantly downregulated in AR; CADM1 highly expressed in plasma cells of seasonal AR; hsa-miR-186-5p–CADM1 axis linked to immune pathways
comments: Mechanistic validation (e.g., miRNA overexpression/knockdown) and functional tests of CADM1 impact on plasma cell activation are absent; cross-sectional design limits causality claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Downregulated exosomal hsa-miR-186-5p permits CADM1 upregulation in plasma cells driving inflammation
hypotheses.result: Supported; miR-186-5p downregulated in AR, CADM1 elevated in plasma cells, pathway enrichment suggestive of immune activation

title: Modeling the impact of prevalence-driven public awareness on dengue dynamics and optimizing multi-intervention control strategies
task: Optimal control of dengue with prevalence-driven awareness dynamics
key_results: 95% peak infection reduction with four-intervention combo vs. 45–80% for single interventions; mosquito mortality elasticity −1.0; outbreak peak reduced from ~2,850 to <150 cases
comments: Strong theoretical framework with sensitivity analysis, but parameter values and awareness transmission mechanisms may be context-specific; validation on real epidemiological data needed.

inputs: human populations (unaware susceptible, aware susceptible, infected, recovered)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Prevalence-driven awareness feedback significantly alters dengue transmission and optimal control
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; awareness parameters (α, ν) show significant negative effects on transmission (PRCC <−0.29, p<0.01)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-intervention portfolios are synergistic and superior to single interventions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; four-control strategy achieves 95% reduction vs. 45–80% for singles

title: Cross-attention-based multimodal fusion for early diabetic retinopathy detection
task: Early diabetic retinopathy detection via multimodal fusion
key_results: 96% accuracy overall; 83% F1-score for Stage 1 early detection; cross-attention fusion outperforms simple concatenation baselines
comments: Strong performance but limited discussion of clinical validation on independent cohorts or comparison with ophthalmologist-level performance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cross-attention fusion captures richer cross-modal interactions than late-stage integration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; fusion model outperforms unimodal and concatenation baselines

title: High angular resolution diffusion imaging of neurodevelopment in children through data creation with deep learning
task: Synthetic HARDI generation via deep learning for pediatric neuroimaging
key_results: Predicted b2000 data shows patterns similar to acquired data; tract volumes exhibit consistent sex differences; scan time reduced by ~50%
comments: Validation limited to 71 subjects; potential error propagation from predicted HARDI not fully characterized for clinical biomarkers.

inputs: b750 s/mm² diffusion MRI (30 directions, 5 b0)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deep learning can synthesize high-b-value HARDI from low-b data and enable neurodevelopmental analysis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; predicted metrics correlate with acquired data across 8 tracts and show age/sex effects

title: Gaussian splashing enables direct volumetric rendering underwater
task: 3D reconstruction and rendering of underwater scenes
key_results: Reconstruction in minutes (vs. hours); 140 FPS rendering (vs. <1 FPS); competitive reconstruction quality with improved backscatter handling
comments: Gaussian Splashing unifies speed of 3DGS with underwater-specific image formation modeling; practical for real-time underwater imaging despite occlusion by water absorption.

hypotheses.hypothesis: 3DGS adaptation with scattering model enables fast underwater rendering
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 140 FPS with competitive quality and better backscatter handling

title: Continuous-surface 3D reconstruction from kilometer-range single-photon LiDAR using score-based priors
task: 3D scene reconstruction from single-photon LiDAR using score-based priors
key_results: Continuous-surface representation enabling arbitrary-resolution rendering; data compression and guided super-resolution of 3D videos; robust imaging through camouflage with multiple depth layers
comments: Score-based diffusion priors offer flexibility across sensing scenarios; integration of multimodal sensor fusion with learned latent representations is novel, though computational cost of score-based inference not detailed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Score-based priors enable robust reconstruction despite SPAD noise and atmospheric effects
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: demonstrated across multiple sensing scenarios with off-the-shelf priors

title: An enhanced multi-strategy educational competition optimizer for numerical optimization
task: Enhanced multi-strategy optimization for numerical and engineering problems
key_results: EMSECO Friedman rankings: 1.2 (10D), 1.4 (30D), 1.7 (50D), 2.0 (100D) on CEC 2017; outperforms AE, MRFO, SAO, EOSMA, ALSHADE, EPSCA; validated on 7 real-world engineering problems
comments: Three synergistic mechanisms (undergraduate diversity, graduate exploitation, random restart) address ECO limitations; superior convergence and diversity preservation demonstrated, though scalability to higher dimensions and theoretical analysis limited.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-strategy mechanisms improve exploration-exploitation balance vs. standard ECO
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: superior Friedman rankings across all dimensionalities

title: Secure multi-party biometric verification using QKD assisted quantum oblivious transfer
task: Secure multiparty biometric verification using quantum oblivious transfer and QKD
key_results: QOT rate up to 25.8 km distance: 8.8×10⁻³ OTs/sec (113 sec/OT) back-to-back, 0.11 OTs/sec (9.1 sec/OT) with pre-distributed keys; fingerprint matching use case: 20 min 39 sec for 128 OTs with 128-bit messages
comments: Experimentally feasible integration of entanglement-based QOT and QKD; practical rate remains slow for large-scale deployment, limited by entanglement source; privacy-preserving fingerprint matching via MASCOT is compelling application.

model_io.model: Polarization-encoded QOT protocol with QKD authentication

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integrated QOT-QKD physical layer enables efficient secure multiparty computation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: parallel QKD pipeline for authentication; privacy-preserving fingerprint matching demonstrated over quantum channel

title: An adaptive modified Newton–Raphson-based optimizer for efficient optimal power flow performance under multiple operating conditions
task: Adaptive optimal power flow with renewable integration and multiple operating conditions
key_results: MNRBO outperforms NRBO and state-of-the-art on IEEE 30-bus: better solutions, faster/more consistent convergence, lower inter-run variation across fuel cost minimization, prohibited zones, and transmission loss scenarios; probabilistic OPF with PEM and lognormal irradiance validated
comments: Adaptive Crossover Mechanism + sigmoid decay strategy provide smooth exploration-to-exploitation transition; ablation study demonstrates individual contribution of each component; practical value for real power system operation under renewable uncertainty.

model_io.model: Modified Newton-Raphson-Based Optimizer (MNRBO) with adaptive components

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive Crossover Mechanism + sigmoid decay improve convergence vs. NRBO
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: MNRBO achieves lower cost, faster/more stable convergence across all test cases

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sigmoid decay provides more predictable convergence than abrupt/polynomial decay
hypotheses.result: Supported: results show steadier convergence under renewable uncertainty

title: Deep learning for time-series segmentation of mechanical ventilator waveforms
task: Segmentation of mechanical ventilator waveforms for asynchrony detection
key_results: F1 scores >0.99 for inspiratory/expiratory onset detection; outperformed rule-based methods; robust performance on asynchronous breaths (F1 ≥0.98)
comments: Practical clinical deployment is enabled by computational efficiency, though validation on external datasets beyond 33 patients would strengthen generalizability claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deep learning outperforms heuristic segmentation methods on noisy ventilator data
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: F1>0.99 vs. large deviations in heuristic methods

hypotheses.hypothesis: Model leverages diverse waveform features for segmentation
hypotheses.result: Supported by Grad-CAM analysis showing diverse feature importance

title: Research on factors influencing teaching staff’s continued use intention of AIGC tools: based on structural equation modeling and artificial neural networks
task: Modeling AIGC tool adoption continuance intention in higher education
key_results: PLS-SEM: perceived usefulness, satisfaction, effort/performance expectancy significantly predict continuance; ANN importance ranking: performance expectancy > satisfaction > expectation confirmation > effort expectancy > perceived usefulness
comments: Hybrid PLS-SEM + ANN approach is novel for continuance modeling; social influence and perceived risk surprisingly non-significant, possibly reflecting sample-specific or cultural factors.

inputs: survey data from 310 HE teaching staff: UTAUT/ECM constructs (effort expectancy, social influence, perceived usefulness, satisfaction, perceived risk, expectation confirmation)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Satisfaction and perceived usefulness mediate expectation confirmation → continuance intention
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: significant positive indirect effects via satisfaction pathway

hypotheses.hypothesis: Social influence affects continuance intention
hypotheses.result: Rejected: no significant effect on continuance intention

title: CASE-GANet : Context-aware and semantic-enhanced generative adversarial network for infrared and visible image fusion
task: Infrared-visible image fusion with semantic awareness
key_results: Outperformed state-of-the-art on TNO and Road Scene datasets; improved perceptual quality, structural fidelity, and thermal target visibility via semantic guidance
comments: Context-Aware Multi-Head Attention (C-MHA) injection of semantic knowledge via learnable bias is intuitive, but quantitative improvement margins over recent baselines and computational overhead not explicitly stated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Semantic segmentation guidance improves IR-VI fusion over modality-agnostic attention
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: CASE-GANet outperforms attention-only baselines on standard benchmarks

title: A multi-scale feature fusion network for CNV segmentation in SD-OCT images toward quantitative assessment of neovascular AMD
task: Choroidal neovascularization segmentation in SD-OCT for AMD quantification
key_results: Automatic MFF-Net: IoU=0.686; interactive version (4-point guidance): IoU=0.802; gradient constraint improves boundary delineation; outperforms compared methods
comments: Multi-scale feature fusion with gradient-based loss and optional interactive attention (via Gaussian heatmap from extreme points) provides practical pathway for clinical adoption when full automation insufficient.

model_io.model: Multi-scale Feature Fusion Network (MFF-Net) encoder-decoder with optional interactive attention
inputs: SD-OCT images (automatic or with 4 extreme points for interactive mode)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-scale fusion + gradient constraint improves CNV boundary delineation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: automatic IoU=0.686, outperforming compared methods

hypotheses.hypothesis: Interactive guidance via extreme points substantially improves segmentation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: IoU improvement from 0.686→0.802 with minimal user effort

title: Comparative analysis of CNN–LSTM and CNN–BiLSTM hybrid deep learning models for solar radiation prediction
task: Solar radiation forecasting using CNN-LSTM vs. CNN-BiLSTM
key_results: CNN-LSTM: MAE=0.0880, R²=0.31, APB=1.89%; CNN-BiLSTM: MAE=0.1015, R²=0.15, APB=5.98%; reconstructed irradiance R²=0.7884
comments: The controlled comparison explicitly avoids state-of-the-art claims and highlights that CNN-LSTM offers practical accuracy-efficiency balance; negative skill scores indicate room for fundamental improvement.

inputs: multivariate climate variables from NASA POWER (Delhi, India)

hypotheses.hypothesis: CNN-BiLSTM bidirectional processing improves solar radiation prediction
hypotheses.result: Rejected: CNN-LSTM outperformed CNN-BiLSTM across all metrics

key_results: Finite-time convergence via velocity observer; fixed-time convergence avoiding settling-time dependence; convergence conditions derived via Lyapunov and stability theory
comments: Practical contribution for second-order multi-agent systems lacking direct velocity feedback; numerical validation provided but real-world network scalability unclear.

title: Determinants of pregnancy termination among ever-married women of reproductive age in Bangladesh
task: Predicting pregnancy termination risk factors using machine learning
key_results: Random Forest: 66.2% accuracy, 71.8% AUC; top factors: number of children, employment status, age at first sex; Boruta+SHAP/LIME feature interpretation
comments: Moderate performance (AUC 0.72) limits clinical utility; class imbalance and sensitive outcome definition warrant further investigation of sampling strategies.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Random Forest identifies key pregnancy termination predictors better than other ML algorithms
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: RF highest accuracy (66.2%) and AUC (71.8%) among five models tested

title: Acoustic-vibration characteristics of steel-spring floating-slab track based on acoustic wave superposition method
task: Prediction of acoustic radiation characteristics of steel-spring floating-slab track
key_results: Acoustic wave superposition method achieves comparable accuracy to boundary element method with significantly faster computation; floating-slab length and thickness are dominant design parameters for low-frequency noise control
comments: The method efficiently combines vehicle-track dynamics with acoustic radiation prediction, though the paper would benefit from explicit computational time comparisons with BEM.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Floating-slab exhibits strong low-frequency acoustic radiation ability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; identified as dominant low-frequency noise source

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structural parameters significantly affect acoustic characteristics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; length and thickness variations strongly influence radiation patterns
